blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Tatiana Prozorova – Singapore Open Round of 16 SINGAPORE–Alex Eala’s long-awaited main draw debut in the Singapore Open came to an abrupt and disappointing end on Thursday night. In a tournament where she’s heavily expected to reach at least the final, Eala was knocked out by unheralded Russian Tatiana Prozorova, 6-4, 5-7, 3-6, in a grueling Round of 16 duel at OCBC Arena Center Court. “Honestly, I don’t have any words right now to describe my feelings, my emotions.
